workflowSpecificationHardening.stepOrdering: Checkout (Step 1) strictly precedes diagnostic directory creation (Step 2)
workflowSpecificationHardening.contextPassing: GitHub expressions mapped to step env: and accessed via quoted shell variables (${DISPATCHED_REF}, ${DISPATCHED_SHA})
workflowSpecificationHardening.immutableShaVerification: git rev-parse HEAD strictly asserted against fixed env APPROVED_BASELINE_SHA in Step 3
workflowSpecificationHardening.pipefailEnforced: set -eo pipefail enforced on all test steps to preserve non-zero exit codes
workflowSpecificationHardening.diagnosticsHandling: Step 12 collects container state with if: always(); Step 13 uploads artifacts with 7-day retention
